blocks.text: And this parable is of a sort with that, which is in the Prophet Isaiah, which is (given) in this manner: “My beloved had a vineyard on the horn of a fat place. And he cultivated it, and surrounded it with a fence, and planted in it vines, and built a Tower within it. He also made a wine-press in it. And he expected that it would produce grapes; but it produced wild grapes.”
